cur:catacombs2-zaragoza-petrine-trilogy.summary: The left part of this frieze is given to three scenes of Peter: the miracle of the spring, his arrest, and Christ foretelling his denial as the cockerel stands by. A praying woman, the orant, occupies the centre; to the right Christ heals a blind man, changes water into wine at Cana, multiplies the loaves and fishes and, at the far end, raises Lazarus from his tomb.
facts: The three Peter scenes on the left gave the sarcophagus its modern name, the 'Petrine trilogy'.
Spanish Wikipedia attributes it to the Roman workshop that produced the Sarcophagus of the Two Brothers in the Vatican.
Only the front is carved; it was restored in 1991.
